books-search-server.description: Book search and full-text retrieval across OpenLibrary, Google Books, HebrewBooks.org (JSONP/Suggest/Shas/PDF), Sefaria.org, and Internet Archive OCR.

tools.name: search_books
tools.description: Search across OpenLibrary, Google Books, HebrewBooks.org, and Sefaria.org catalogs.

query.description: Search query, title, or Sefaria reference

tools.name: fetch_ia_text
tools.description: Fetch public domain OCR text from Internet Archive by IA ID or OpenLibrary Work key, or check CDL status.

ia_id.description: Internet Archive identifier or OL...W key

tools.name: fetch_book_text
tools.description: Fetch full text from OpenLibrary/IA, Sefaria.org reference, or HebrewBooks Shas.

book_id.description: Book ID, IA ID, Sefaria ref (e.g. 'Berakhot 2a'), or 'shas:1:2'

local-books-server.description: Local PDF/EPUB/TXT/MD book library indexer and search engine using PyMuPDF and SQLite FTS5 (unicode61 + trigram) with Hebrew nikkud stripping, visual-RTL PDF repair, and prefix/sofit expansion.

tools.name: index_local_books
tools.description: Index local PDF, EPUB, TXT, and Markdown books into the SQLite FTS5 search engine.

paths.description: Directory or file path to index

tools.name: search_local_books
tools.description: Full-text search across indexed local books with Hebrew nikkud stripping, prefix expansion, and legacy PDF repair.

tools.name: get_local_book_page
tools.description: Fetch full text of a specific page from an indexed local book.

file_path_or_title.description: Book file path or title substring

social-data-server.description: Social networks search and personal account reader across X.com (SocialData & personal cookies), Instagram (Apify & personal sessionid), Facebook, and Exa neural search.

tools.name: search_social
tools.description: Search social media posts across X.com, Instagram, and Facebook using managed APIs or personal session cookies.

tools.name: search_socialdata_tweets
tools.description: Direct search on X.com via SocialData.tools with advanced operators (lang:he, min_faves).

tools.name: fetch_personal_x_timeline
tools.description: Read personal X.com Bookmarks or Home Timeline using X_AUTH_TOKEN and X_CT0 session cookies.

tools.name: fetch_personal_instagram_feed
tools.description: Read personal Instagram saved posts or profile feed using IG_SESSIONID cookie.

forum-search-server.description: Community discussion boards search across Reddit (Arctic Shift), Rotter.net Scoops (Windows-1255), Discourse, and SERP Dorking.

tools.name: search_reddit_arctic_shift
tools.description: Search Reddit submissions via the keyless Arctic Shift community archive.

tools.name: fetch_rotter_scoops
tools.description: Fetch real-time breaking scoops from Rotter.net news RSS with Windows-1255 decoding.

tools.name: search_discourse_forum
tools.description: Search any developer Discourse forum (e.g. discuss.python.org, Hugging Face).

tools.name: build_serp_forum_dork
tools.description: Construct precision Google Dork query for Cloudflare-protected boards (FXP, Quora, Tapuz).

tools.name: search_stackexchange
tools.description: Search StackExchange Q&A sites (StackOverflow, ServerFault, Mi Yodeya judaism, etc.).

news-search-server.description: Real-time news retrieval across Google News RSS (Hebrew/English), 12 Israeli news RSS portals, Telegram public channel web previews, and GDELT 2.0.

tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Search breaking news across Google News RSS, Israeli portals (ynet, haaretz, mako, globes, maariv, walla, c14, inn, bhol), Telegram channels, and GDELT.

source.description: google_news, ynet, haaretz, mako, globes, maariv, walla, c14, inn, bhol, telegram:amitsegal, or gdelt

tools.name: fetch_israeli_rss
tools.description: Fetch latest breaking news from a specific Israeli Hebrew news RSS portal.

source.description: Portal key: ynet, haaretz, mako, globes, maariv, walla, c14, inn, bhol, jpost, kan, 972mag

tools.name: fetch_telegram_channel
tools.description: Fetch latest posts from a public Telegram channel web preview (e.g. amitsegal, abualiexpress).
